_comment: Bill of materials excerpt for DCU-A1 / DCU-B2 with lifecycle status. Looked up by the copilot's lookup_part tool.

parts.description: 32-bit automotive microcontroller, 512 kB flash, LQFP-64, AEC-Q100 Grade 1
parts.notes: Grade 2 variant (-G2) is NOT released for DCU (ambient up to 125 °C required at door module).

parts.description: H-bridge motor driver 5 A continuous, HTSSOP-28, AEC-Q100 Grade 1
parts.notes: Pin-compatible successor HB4830; qualification target 2026-12-15; LTB bridge quantity approx. 1.1 million.

parts.description: H-bridge motor driver 5 A continuous, HTSSOP-28, AEC-Q100 Grade 1, 130 nm BCD
parts.notes: Lower over-current threshold (7.0 A vs 7.5 A) – software stall detection must be verified.

parts.description: 12-pin press-fit vehicle connector, pins 5/6 = LIN, pins 1/2 = supply
parts.notes: Pin length tolerance critical for press-fit; see FMEA-DCU-B2 item 7. Incoming inspection: pin length sampling per lot.

parts.description: Keyless-entry LF antenna front-end (variant B only)
parts.notes: Periodic polling in sleep mode adds approx. 90 µA to quiescent current of DCU-B2.
